artifact.subject: Re: Feedback on proposed solutions
artifact.body:
Aadesh,

Thanks for the candid reply. We can reshape the proposal as a phased program or a smaller initial scope so the first commitment fits this year’s planning limits.

To make that useful, could you share the annual budget ceiling and the approval path you are working to? That will let us align the structure with what you can actually justify.

Quinn is copied so any scope change stays aligned.

Best regards,
Mei Chen

artifact.subject: Working session to build the return case
artifact.body:
Aadesh and Quinn,

The return question is best handled together, with QuantumLeap’s own figures in front of us. I’d like to schedule a working session to model a phased scope and show how the business case would look against your current-year assumptions.

Aadesh can bring the strategy and approval context; Quinn can bring the workflow and integration details. Please send two times that work, and I’ll send the invite.

Best regards,
Mei Chen

artifact.subject: Budget owner and approval path check
artifact.body:
Before offering any pricing concession, identify who owns QuantumLeap’s annual plan figure and who must sign off a phased structure.

Confirm the budget owner, the planned amount, and the approval route. Check with pricing desk what structure can be modeled once the constraint is known. Record the economic buyer and decision process in CRM.
